note: Human imperfection is structural, not a style scalar. An exaggeration dial makes a whole read more dramatic; a distressed person instead breaks at specific places - restarts a word, stops to breathe, drops in level, trails off. Those are events at positions, so they are scripted and seeded here rather than left to the model. Engine-agnostic: any TTS that renders a fragment can drive it.

fragments.intent: false start - begins the word, stops

fragments.text: I can hear you walking around upstairs.

jitter.note: seeded per fragment so the same script reproduces exactly
